description.p: AnimaEngine keeps a transparent animation anchored above normal windows on the niri Wayland compositor, drawn with a layer-shell surface and wgpu. Frames are decoded once and cached; optional BC7 blocks keep large animations small on the GPU, and transparent padding is cropped away so the art can reach a screen edge.
Companion tools control the overlay (input mode, scale, rotation, position), download and play Steam Workshop items through SteamCMD, and manage the translation catalog.
